scope: isolated real-parser replay; ASTs retained through phase, initialization/digest/teardown excluded; does not equal the whole PHPStan phase

native.purpose: exploratory instruction feedback, not an acceptance gate

opcode_budget.note: Exact recorded PC instruction costs grouped only when the executed/direct machine CFG is reachable from one opcode target without crossing central dispatch. Shared tails, setup and called functions are not attributed to an individual opcode. Direct conditional edges are conservative; this is a lower bound for each body, not an inclusive opcode cost.
